hint_adb_missing: Install Android platform-tools or add adb to the desktop session PATH. Details in the console.
hint_adb_failed: Run "adb kill-server" and press ↻. Details in the console.
hint_dev_unauthorized: Unlock the phone, allow USB debugging and press ↻.
hint_dev_offline: Unplug and replug the USB cable and press ↻.
err_dev_no_permissions: no USB permissions for the device
hint_dev_no_permissions: Check the Android udev rules and reconnect the phone.
hint_no_device: Connect the phone via USB with debugging enabled and press ↻.
hint_bad_args: Check the quotes in "Extra arguments" (⚙️ Advanced).
hint_scrcpy_missing: Install scrcpy or add its folder to the desktop session PATH. Details in the console.
hint_scrcpy_exec: Check that scrcpy is executable. Details in the console.
hint_scrcpy_failed: Read the ERROR: lines in the console.
msg_restart: Application restart is required to apply changes.
tcpip: Wifi connection (requieres USB connection at first)
